name: zumen-monorepo
description: Monorepo of zumen: read, view and measure 2D drawings (SXF, JWW, DXF and DWG) in the browser, Rust and Python

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/viewer/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/sxf/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/jww/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/dxf/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/reader/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run wasm && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm audit && pnpm run build && pnpm run playground:build && pnpm run check:rust && pnpm run check:scripts && pnpm run check:python
scripts.check:python: uv run --project bindings/python --frozen ruff check bindings/python && uv run --project bindings/python --frozen ruff format --check bindings/python && uv run --project bindings/python --frozen maturin develop --uv -m bindings/python/Cargo.toml && uv run --project bindings/python --frozen pytest bindings/python/tests -q
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --exclude zumen-python && cargo build -p zumen-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && node scripts/notices.mjs --check
